tools.name: whoami
tools.title: My collaboration identity
tools.description: Discover your broker-verified peer identity and the collaboration groups currently available to this session. The native connection determines who you are. Use after_group to continue a partial group list.

tools.title: List collaborators
tools.description: List peers and their public status in an explicit group. Use this to understand who is participating and decide when sharing a finding, question, review or disagreement would help. Continue with after_peer when more peers remain.

tools.name: send_message
tools.title: Send to collaborators
tools.description: Send a finding, question, proposed solution, review or disagreement to explicit recipients in one group. Choose when communication is useful; no forced turn-taking or reply count applies. Use a stable client_key for this logical message and reuse the same key and arguments if its outcome is uncertain. Saved means durably recorded, not read or accepted. reply_to links a discussion. Attachments cite registered sources; they do not grant access to files.

client_key.description: Stable deduplication key, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

body.description: Message text, at most 1 MiB of UTF-8.

anyOf.description: Optional topic, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.
Opaque observation reference, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

examples.body: I found a race in the reconnect path.

tools.name: acknowledge_message
tools.title: Acknowledge a message
tools.description: Explicitly acknowledge a fetched message addressed to you. This records receipt acknowledgment; it does not claim agreement, a reply or completed work.

tools.name: publish_status
tools.title: Share my status
tools.description: Publish a short status for your own peer in this group, such as the area you are investigating or a question you need help with. Null or omitted status clears it. A status is self-reported, not a completion guarantee.

anyOf.description: Status text, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

tools.name: resolve_attachment
tools.title: Inspect a cited source
tools.description: Resolve a message attachment to its current authorized source availability. Stale or replaced references are reported explicitly and are never redirected to newer content. This does not read an arbitrary path or return transcript content.
